name: 展開した学習モジュール
prompt:
Create ONE isolated expanded Japanese syllabus module. Input1 ORIGINAL Coursera screenshot PRIMARY for downward-chevron, clock/open-book icon geometry, optical strokes, proportions, alignment and fine details. Input2 Japanese mock SECONDARY exact existing Japanese content and typography; it omits both metadata icons and uses a heavy green chevron. Input3 official Lighthouse finish only; no bus.
Only source region x48 y1158 width1082 height786 in1179x2676. No section heading, recommendations, other modules, enrollment or navigation. Pure white390x280 logical canvas, side inset16 and neutral fine lower divider aty269. No enclosing card, tint, shadow or selection.
Header: left「第1章」Meiryo REGULAR40012px line16 mutedgray; main heading atx80「プログラミングの基礎」Meiryo BOLD14 line24 dark. Far-right small downward chevron12x6 with original source rounded moderate stroke, coherent slate #526173, no green. Expanded state.
Body startsy46, Meiryo REGULAR40014px line24, zero spacing, exact five left-aligned lines:
なぜプログラムを書くのでしょうか。
この講義では計算機の基本構造と、
最初のプログラムの組み立て方を学びます。
変数、条件、繰り返しなどの考え方を、
例題を通して確かめていきましょう。
At y190 restore original small thin circular clock outline with right-angle hands, slate #526173, before「完了まで約9時間」Meiryo Regular12/16 mutedgray. At y226 restore original small thin open-book outline icon, source page/center-fold anatomy, slate, before「映像4本・問題2問・読み物2件」Regular12/16 mutedgray. Align both icon/text metadata rows consistently.
Preserve exact native Japanese text, punctuation and line breaks, fine Regular strokes visibly lighter than heading. No English or extra prose/icons/rows. No primary CTA in this component, so white neutral/slate finish only. High-resolution flat readable UI raster.
reviewNotes: Inspected exact Japanese header, five body lines and both metadata strings; clock/open-book source anatomy restored in slate, downward chevron/white surface/lower divider retained. Regular body and metadata distinct from Bold heading. Condensed native copy preserved. No runtime/native/font-metric acceptance claimed.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
